subject: Credit appendix & onboarding package request — DevSeed Labs
messages:
From: Anna Zhou <anna@devseed.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: credit appendix & usage carveout for DevSeed Labs

Hi Markus / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency profile. We're getting internal buy-in but have two asks before we move to a short pilot: 1) a clear appendix that documents eligibility and accounting for startup credits, and 2) a short-term onboarding package that gives us a predictable buffer while we integrate.

Quick context: DevSeed expects a 6–8 week spike in token usage during model tuning (estimate ~50M tokens) and then a steady 2–5M tokens/month afterwards. The pilot will be public cloud (US) and we need to show our finance team how credits will be applied to usage and any reconciliation timeline.

Can Redwood provide an "appendix" we can pass to our CFO that states how promotional credits are applied, expiry, and whether unused credits can be rolled into a prepaid top-up? Also, is there a short onboarding package you can offer (credits + 30 days of burst capacity) that we can include in our internal approval packet?

I attached a sketch term sheet from our side for reference. Looping in our counsel on the legal timing: contracts@mayaventures.com (they'll need DocuSign timing).

Appreciate your help — happy to set a 30-min call if helpful.

Best,
Anna
Anna Zhou
Head of Platform
DevSeed Labs

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Zhou <anna@devseed.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: credit appendix & usage carveout for DevSeed Labs

Thanks Anna — great to hear the demo landed.

Short answers up front: we can produce a formal "Credit Eligibility & Application Appendix" that clarifies promo credit lifecycle (issuance, offset against monthly usage, expiry, and edge-case reconciliation). We also have a one-time onboarding credit package we can tailor — typical structure is upfront token credit + 30 days of burst capacity with an agreed throttling floor.

To size the package precisely I need two small numbers from you:
- expected peak daily tokens during tuning (ballpark)
- whether the pilot will use streaming or batched generation (impacts cost model)

If it's helpful, I can draft the appendix language and a joint statement that your CFO can attach to the term sheet. I'm copying Karthik (pricing) and Laura (finance) to align on the financial reconciliation cadence and any accounting constraints.

Proposed next step: if you can share the peak estimate I will draft a one-pager appendix + onboarding package proposal by Thu.

On process:
- Attachments and legal: for any promo exceptions we typically require a short SOW addendum and DocuSign signature; legal review usually takes 3–5 business days once we have the credit amount locked.
- Roll-forward policy: by default credits expire 12 months from issuance; we can discuss a 3-month rollover carveout for programmatic partners with an approved finance sign-off.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none)

From: Anna Zhou <anna@devseed.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Ventures Legal <contracts@mayaventures.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 08:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: credit appendix & usage carveout for DevSeed Labs

Hi Markus — thanks. Quick answers below and attaching the term sheet with usage projections filled in.

Peak daily tokens: ~4.5M tokens on peak tuning days (we estimate 10–12 days of that intensity).
Usage mode: largely streaming for chat-based model tuning, with some batch eval jobs (< 10% of total).

What we'd like to request formally:
1) Onboarding package: 60k USD equivalent in promo credits applied up front, plus 60 days of burst capacity (no throttling for the first 30 days, then soft throttle).
2) Credit appendix: explicit clause that credits are applied monthly as an offset to invoice and that unused credits after 60 days may be eligible for a one-time 30-day roll-forward upon written request.
3) Legal timing: we need the DocuSign execution no later than July 8 to align with our board approval cadence.

I've attached the updated term sheet and highlighted the board deadline. Our legal is on the thread if you need to coordinate language.

Thanks — happy to hop on a call Thursday afternoon PT if that helps speed things.

Anna

Attachment: DevSeed_Startup_Termsheet_Filled.pdf (application/pdf, 518 KB)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Zhou <anna@devseed.io>, Maya Ventures Legal <contracts@mayaventures.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: recommendation for DevSeed onboarding credits (summarize + next steps)

Team — summarizing the ask from DevSeed and recommended path. Copying the public reply to the customer below and attaching an appendix draft.

Ask recap (from customer):
- 60k USD promo credit upfront (to be applied as monthly invoice offsets)
- 60 days of burst capacity; no hard throttle first 30 days
- 30-day roll-forward option on unused credits, on written request
- DocuSign execution target: July 8

Risk/ops notes:
- Finance impact: 60k credits at list will be recognized as a deferred contra-revenue credit until consumed; Laura, confirm this treatment is OK and whether we need a GL code or memo for recognition.
- Abuse risk: streaming workloads can drive heavy short-duration spikes — recommend we require a short usage safeguard clause (notify at 75% of monthly credit burn and allow a single ad-hoc throttle override if abnormal patterns are detected).
- Legal: we can do an SOW addendum + appendix; turnaround target 3 business days once terms are final. Maya Ventures Legal (on thread) will own the redline window.

Recommendation: approve the package with the following modifications for operational safety:
1) Approve the 60k USD promo credit upfront.
2) Approve 60 days burst, but add a safeguard: soft throttle at 75% of the credit burn rate and an automatic review trigger at 90%. Manual override for first occurrence allowed.
3) Allow a single 30-day roll-forward request, requires written approval from finance and one-sentence justification from the customer.

If Laura and Karthik confirm GL and risk acceptance, I'll send a final appendix and SOW addendum to Anna by Monday (6/28) with DocuSign instructions to hit her July 8 deadline.

Suggested draft reply to DevSeed (for your review):
"Hi Anna — thanks for the details. We can approve the onboarding package you requested (60k USD promotional credit + 60 days burst). Attached is a draft Credit Eligibility Appendix and a short SOW addendum. We added a safeguard clause to help preserve burst capacity for all customers; please review and let us know if your counsel needs changes. If this aligns, we'll send for signature and aim to complete DocuSign by July 6 to meet your board timing"

Laura: please confirm accounting/GL path.
Karthik: any pricing concerns on consumption rate modeling?

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
